eyebrow: The internal stage and file format
caption: A real Snowsight stage-creation dialog -- Driftwood's driftwood_raw_stage follows this same CSV file-format pattern.
LIST @stage on a real external stage -- Driftwood's own stage paths are partitioned the same way: billing/dt=2026-10-17/.

code:
COPY INTO driftwood_analytics.raw.billing_events
FROM @driftwood_raw_stage/billing/dt=2026-10-17/
FILE_FORMAT = (FORMAT_NAME = raw.csv_format)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';
caption: One bad row aborts the whole load -- no silent partial day.
A real Snowsight Query History / Query Profile pane for a COPY INTO statement -- real duration, real rows loaded.

code:
COPY INTO driftwood_analytics.raw.billing_events
